name: manual_unique
description: Manually calculated unique optimum; both reports match and unused-group costs are included.

name: negative_edge_costs
description: Negative log-density edge costs remain valid; complete matching is optimal.

name: forbidden_edges_and_unused_group
description: An infinite edge is forbidden and the unused predicted-group penalty changes the optimum.

description: Duplicate predicted coordinates remain distinct groups and produce two tied injections.

name: heteroscedastic_labels
description: Per-report uncertainty and label likelihood create different real edge costs.

name: reports_without_groups
description: Reports with no predicted groups all pay report miss costs.
